svg.text: Ship smoke profiles and how they cluster
Rows in clustering order. Cell colour = how far the ship is above (blue) or below (orange) the 14-ship average. The last two columns (outcomes) were not used for clustering.
Smoke type (the lens to compare against) is the coloured word under each ship name: long DD, short DD, cruiser, exhaust
How alike two ships are (0 = identical profile; darker = more alike)
